title: Karbala chalo, karbala chalo
body:
Karbala chalo, karbala chalo, karbala chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala karbala karbala..(2)
<<MINI>>
Allahumm-ar-zuqna ziyarat al hussain..(2)
Karbala chalo... karbala chalo..(4)
Karbala chalo... karbala chalo..(4)
Karbala chalo... karbala chalo, karbala chalo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Lo aagaya bulawa..(2)
mazloom e karbala ka...
1. Maa muntazir hai bete ke ghumkhaar aayenge
aakar mere Hussain a.s pe aasu bahaenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Bint e rasool takti hai..(2)
tum sabka raasta.... karbala chalo....
2. Zahra (s.a) ka laal qabr mein hasrat ye le gaya
Akbar(a.s) ka kalma goyo ne pursa nhi diya
<<DIVIDER>>
ab sheh ko pursa dena hai..(2)
kadiyal jawaan ka.... karbala chalo....
3. Jee bhar ke apne bhai ko zainab(s.a) na ro saki
majlis zameen e karbobala par na ho saki
<<DIVIDER>>
armaan e sayyeda mein..(2)
bichad e safe azaa.... karbala chalo....
4. Khanjar tale Hussain(a.s) ki aahein gawaah hai
halmin mugheesuna ki sadaein gawaah hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kab se hume bulata hai..(2)
Zahra(s.a) ka laadla.... karbala chalo....
5. Jis khaak ne chupaya tha bint e Ali ka sar
jisne kafan banaya tha laash e Hussain(a.s) par
<<DIVIDER>>
us karbala ki khaak ka..(2)
karne ko shukriyaa.... karbala chalo....
6. Baazu katake jis jagah Abbas(a.s) so gaye
armaan bawafa ke jaha'n dafn hogaye
<<DIVIDER>>
aasu waha girayenge..(2)
paani jaha'n gira.... karbala chalo....
7. Qismat se waqt aayega jab ye hayaat mein
tum apne betiyo'n ko bhi le jaana saath mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar(a.s) ko wo sunayengi..(2)
sughra(s.a) ka marsiya.... karbala chalo....
8. Ek saal baad bhai ka sar jis ghadi mila
Abid(a.s) se roke kehti thi ye binte sayyeda
<<DIVIDER>>
dafnaungi mai hatho'n se..(2)
sar apne bhai ka.... karbala chalo....
9. Chehlum bhi apne baap ka bachhi na kar saki
roti hui wo shaam ke zindaa'n mein marr gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
ae kaash koi kehde Sakina(s.a) se ye zara
<<MINI>>
karbala chalo....
<<DIVIDER>>
Labbaik, Labbaik, Labbaik Ya Hussain..(2)
Halabikum ya zawwari, halabikum
abad wallah ya zahra ma ninsa hussaina
10. Is saal arbaeen pe aisa ho ehtemaam
ae kaash zaero'n mein ho shamil hamara naam aur de hamein bhi hazrat e abbas ye sadaa
<<MINI>>
karbala chalo....
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Ghurbat musafiron'n ki musafir samajh sakein
kaise chali thi bibiya'n andaza ho humein
aasu bahate shehr e najaf se piyada paa
<<MINI>>
karbala chalo....
<<DIVIDER>>
12. Chehlum pe jaise aati hai Zainab(s.a) bhi shaam se
izn e safar mile jo takallum imaam se
har ek qadam zahoor ki karte hue dua
<<MINI>>
karbala chalo....
Allahumm-ar-zuqna ziyarat al hussain
Karbala chalo, karbala chalo, karbala chalo
